Unordered list produces List and ListItem nodes

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"include_document_structure\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Items:</p><ul><li>Alpha</li><li>Beta</li><li>Gamma</li></ul>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
